## Cost analysis

Cost 30 = **params 30, memory 0** (`_score_v2` → `(0,0,30)`). All cost is the length-30 mask `v`.
`v` must be length 30 (Einsum contraction with the 30-wide canvas axis). Cheapest legal carrier of `v`:
a **dense `[30]` init = 30 params, 0 memory**. Sparse (2 NNZ) is rejected by the scorer's
`check_model(full_check=True)`; any generated/sliced mask forces a ≥120 B charged intermediate.
⇒ **30 is the forced floor; WALL.** Charge asymmetry: params = element count (dtype-free), memory = bytes.

## Don't-do log

  Identity/Transpose/Flip/Rotate matches (0/266). Grader compares full `[1,10,30,30]` exactly (no bbox trim).
- **Do NOT use sparse initializers to cut params.** `calculate_memory`'s `check_model(full_check=True)`

- **Do NOT Slice+Pad or generate the mask** — the crop/mask intermediate (160 B / 120 B) alone exceeds 30.
- **Do NOT shrink the output** to a compact `[1,10,2,2]` — grader compares full-canvas → visible 0.
